```lean
import JaideVerification.Scalar

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

namespace Jaide

variable {α : Type u} [RSFField α]

structure LayerParams (α : Type u) [RSFField α] where
  scaleFn : α → α
  transFn : α → α
  scaleFn_ne_zero : ∀ z : α, scaleFn z ≠ RSFField.zero

def couplingForward (p : LayerParams α) (x : α × α) : α × α :=
  (x.1 * p.scaleFn x.2, x.2 + p.transFn (x.1 * p.scaleFn x.2))

def couplingInverse (p : LayerParams α) (y : α × α) : α × α :=
  (y.1 / p.scaleFn (y.2 - p.transFn y.1), y.2 - p.transFn y.1)

def butterflyForward (y : α × α) : α × α :=
  ((y.1 - y.2) * RSFField.scale, (y.1 + y.2) * RSFField.scale)

def butterflyInverse (z : α × α) : α × α :=
  ((z.1 + z.2) * RSFField.scale, (z.2 - z.1) * RSFField.scale)

def layerForward (p : LayerParams α) (x : α × α) : α × α :=
  butterflyForward (couplingForward p x)

def layerInverse (p : LayerParams α) (y : α × α) : α × α :=
  couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y)

def vectorForward (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) : List (α × α) :=
  v.map (layerForward p)

def vectorInverse (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) : List (α × α) :=
  v.map (layerInverse p)

def stackForward : List (LayerParams α) → List (α × α) → List (α × α)
  | [], v => v
  | p :: rest, v => stackForward rest (vectorForward p v)

def stackInverse : List (LayerParams α) → List (α × α) → List (α × α)
  | [], v => v
  | p :: rest, v => vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v)

theorem prodEq {γ β : Type u} : ∀ {a b : γ × β}, a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2 → a = b
  | (_, _), (_, _), rfl, rfl => rfl

theorem coupling_left_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (x : α × α) :
    couplingInverse p (couplingForward p x) = x :=
  match x with
  | (x1, x2) =>
      have step1 : x2 + p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) - p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) = x2 :=
        RSFField.add_sub_cancel x2 (p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2))
      have step2 : p.scaleFn (x2 + p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) - p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2)) = p.scaleFn x2 :=
        congrArg p.scaleFn step1
      have step3 : x1 * p.scaleFn x2 / p.scaleFn (x2 + p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) - p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2)) = x1 * p.scaleFn x2 / p.scaleFn x2 :=
        congrArg (fun z => x1 * p.scaleFn x2 / z) step2
      have step4 : x1 * p.scaleFn x2 / p.scaleFn x2 = x1 :=
        RSFField.mul_div_cancel x1 (p.scaleFn x2) (p.scaleFn_ne_zero x2)
      have step5 : x1 * p.scaleFn x2 / p.scaleFn (x2 + p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) - p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2)) = x1 :=
        Eq.trans step3 step4
      have step6 : x2 + p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) - p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2) = x2 :=
        RSFField.add_sub_cancel x2 (p.transFn (x1 * p.scaleFn x2))
      prodEq step5 step6

theorem coupling_right_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (y : α × α) :
    couplingForward p (couplingInverse p y) = y :=
  match y with
  | (y1, y2) =>
      have step1 : y2 - p.transFn y1 + p.transFn y1 = y2 :=
        RSFField.sub_add_cancel y2 (p.transFn y1)
      have step2 : p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1) ≠ RSFField.zero :=
        p.scaleFn_ne_zero (y2 - p.transFn y1)
      have step3 : y1 / p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1) * p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1) = y1 :=
        RSFField.div_mul_cancel y1 (p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1)) step2
      have step4 : p.transFn (y1 / p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1) * p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1)) = p.transFn y1 :=
        congrArg p.transFn step3
      have step5 : y2 - p.transFn y1 + p.transFn (y1 / p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1) * p.scaleFn (y2 - p.transFn y1)) = y2 :=
        Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => y2 - p.transFn y1 + p.transFn z) step3) step1
      prodEq step3 step5

theorem butterfly_left_inverse (y : α × α) :
    butterflyInverse (butterflyForward y) = y :=
  match y with
  | (a, b) =>
      have step1 : a - b + (a + b) = a + a :=
        RSFField.sub_add_self a b
      have step2 : (a - b) * RSFField.scale + (a + b) * RSFField.scale = (a - b + a + b) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.add_mul (a - b) (a + b) RSFField.scale)
      have step3 : (a - b + a + b) * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step1
      have step4 : ((a - b) * RSFField.scale + (a + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((a + a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step3
      have step5 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (a + a) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step6 : RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = RSFField.scale_sq :=
        Eq.refl (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale)
      have step7 : (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (a + a) * q) step6
      have step8 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq = a :=
        RSFField.double_half a
      have step9 : ((a - b) * RSFField.scale + (a + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = a :=
        Eq.trans step4 (Eq.trans step5 (Eq.trans step7 step8))
      have step10 : a + b - (a - b) = b + b :=
        RSFField.add_sub_self a b
      have step11 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale = (a + b - (a - b)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.sub_mul (a + b) (a - b) RSFField.scale)
      have step12 : (a + b - (a - b)) * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step10
      have step13 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((b + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step12
      have step14 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (b + b) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step15 : (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (b + b) * q) step6
      have step16 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq = b :=
        RSFField.double_half b
      have step17 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = b :=
        Eq.trans step13 (Eq.trans step14 (Eq.trans step15 step16))
      prodEq step9 step17

theorem butterfly_right_inverse (z : α × α) :
    butterflyForward (butterflyInverse z) = z :=
  match z with
  | (a, b) =>
      have step1 : a + b - (b - a) = a + a :=
        RSFField.add_sub_swap a b
      have step2 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale = (a + b - (b - a)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.sub_mul (a + b) (b - a) RSFField.scale)
      have step3 : (a + b - (b - a)) * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step1
      have step4 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((a + a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step3
      have step5 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (a + a) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step6 : RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = RSFField.scale_sq :=
        Eq.refl (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale)
      have step7 : (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (a + a) * q) step6
      have step8 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq = a :=
        RSFField.double_half a
      have step9 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = a :=
        Eq.trans step4 (Eq.trans step5 (Eq.trans step7 step8))
      have step10 : a + b + (b - a) = b + b :=
        RSFField.add_add_self a b
      have step11 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale = (a + b + (b - a)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.add_mul (a + b) (b - a) RSFField.scale)
      have step12 : (a + b + (b - a)) * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step10
      have step13 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((b + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step12
      have step14 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (b + b) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step15 : (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (b + b) * q) step6
      have step16 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq = b :=
        RSFField.double_half b
      have step17 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = b :=
        Eq.trans step13 (Eq.trans step14 (Eq.trans step15 step16))
      prodEq step9 step17

theorem layer_left_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (x : α × α) :
    layerInverse p (layerForward p x) = x :=
  have step1 : butterflyForward (couplingForward p x) = butterflyForward (couplingForward p x) :=
    Eq.refl (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x))
  have step2 : butterflyInverse (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x)) = couplingForward p x :=
    butterfly_left_inverse (couplingForward p x)
  have step3 : couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x))) = couplingInverse p (couplingForward p x) :=
    congrArg (couplingInverse p) step2
  have step4 : couplingInverse p (couplingForward p x) = x :=
    coupling_left_inverse p x
  Eq.trans step3 step4

theorem layer_right_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (y : α × α) :
    layerForward p (layerInverse p y) = y :=
  have step1 : couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y) = couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y) :=
    Eq.refl (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y))
  have step2 : couplingForward p (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y)) = butterflyInverse y :=
    coupling_right_inverse p (butterflyInverse y)
  have step3 : butterflyForward (couplingForward p (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y))) = butterflyForward (butterflyInverse y) :=
    congrArg butterflyForward step2
  have step4 : butterflyForward (butterflyInverse y) = y :=
    butterfly_right_inverse y
  Eq.trans step3 step4

theorem map_left_inverse {β : Type u} (f g : β → β) (h : ∀ x : β, g (f x) = x) :
    ∀ l : List β, (l.map f).map g = l
  | [] =>
      have base : ([] : List β).map f = [] :=
        Eq.refl ([] : List β)
      have base2 : ([] : List β).map g = [] :=
        Eq.refl ([] : List β)
      Eq.trans (congrArg List.map base) base2
  | a :: t =>
      have ih : ((t.map f).map g) = t :=
        map_left_inverse f g h t
      have head : g (f a) = a :=
        h a
      have cons1 : (f a :: t.map f).map g = g (f a) :: (t.map f).map g :=
        Eq.refl ((f a :: t.map f).map g)
      have cons2 : g (f a) :: (t.map f).map g = a :: (t.map f).map g :=
        congrArg (fun u => u :: (t.map f).map g) head
      have cons3 : a :: (t.map f).map g = a :: t :=
        congrArg (fun u => a :: u) ih
      Eq.trans (Eq.trans cons1 cons2) cons3

theorem vector_left_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) :
    vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) = v :=
  have def1 : layerForward p = layerForward p :=
    Eq.refl (layerForward p)
  have def2 : layerInverse p = layerInverse p :=
    Eq.refl (layerInverse p)
  have h : ∀ x : α × α, layerInverse p (layerForward p x) = x :=
    layer_left_inverse p
  map_left_inverse (layerForward p) (layerInverse p) h v

theorem vector_right_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) :
    vectorForward p (vectorInverse p v) = v :=
  have def1 : layerInverse p = layerInverse p :=
    Eq.refl (layerInverse p)
  have def2 : layerForward p = layerForward p :=
    Eq.refl (layerForward p)
  have h : ∀ x : α × α, layerForward p (layerInverse p x) = x :=
    layer_right_inverse p
  map_left_inverse (layerInverse p) (layerForward p) h v

theorem stack_left_inverse :
    ∀ (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (v : List (α × α)),
      stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) = v
  | [], v =>
      have base : stackForward [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      have base2 : stackInverse [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      Eq.trans (congrArg (stackInverse []) base) base2
  | p :: rest, v =>
      have rec : stackForward (p :: rest) v = stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) :=
        Eq.refl (stackForward (p :: rest) v)
      have rec2 : stackInverse (p :: rest) (stackForward (p :: rest) v) = vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v)) :=
        Eq.refl (stackInverse (p :: rest) (stackForward (p :: rest) v))
      have ih : stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v) = vectorForward p v :=
        stack_left_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)
      have step : stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v) = vectorForward p v :=
        ih
      have app : vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v)) = vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) :=
        congrArg (vectorInverse p) step
      have fin : vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) = v :=
        vector_left_inverse p v
      Eq.trans app fin

theorem stack_right_inverse :
    ∀ (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (v : List (α × α)),
      stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) = v
  | [], v =>
      have base : stackInverse [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      have base2 : stackForward [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      Eq.trans (congrArg (stackForward []) base) base2
  | p :: rest, v =>
      have rec : stackInverse (p :: rest) v = vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v) :=
        Eq.refl (stackInverse (p :: rest) v)
      have rec2 : stackForward (p :: rest) (stackInverse (p :: rest) v) = stackForward rest (vectorForward p (stackInverse rest v)) :=
        Eq.refl (stackForward (p :: rest) (stackInverse (p :: rest) v))
      have ih : stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) = v :=
        stack_right_inverse rest v
      have step : stackInverse rest v = v :=
        ih
      have mid : stackInverse rest v = v :=
        step
      have app : vectorForward p (stackInverse rest v) = vectorForward p v :=
        congrArg (vectorForward p) mid
      have fin : stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) = v :=
        stack_right_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)
      Eq.trans app fin

theorem stackForward_injective (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (u v : List (α × α))
    (h : stackForward ps u = stackForward ps v) : u = v :=
  have left_u : stackLeft_inverse ps u = u :=
    stack_left_inverse ps u
  have left_v : stack_left_inverse ps v = v :=
    stack_left_inverse ps v
  have sym_u : u = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) :=
    Eq.symm left_u
  have sym_v : v = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) :=
    Eq.symm left_v
  have cong : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) :=
    congrArg (stackInverse ps) h
  Eq.trans sym_u (Eq.trans cong sym_v)

theorem stackInverse_injective (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (u v : List (α × α))
    (h : stackInverse ps u = stackInverse ps v) : u = v :=
  have right_u : stack_right_inverse ps u = u :=
    stack_right_inverse ps u
  have right_v : stack_right_inverse ps v = v :=
    stack_right_inverse ps v
  have sym_u : u = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps u) :=
    Eq.symm right_u
  have sym_v : v = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) :=
    Eq.symm right_v
  have cong : stackForward ps (stackInverse ps u) = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) :=
    congrArg (stackForward ps) h
  Eq.trans sym_u (Eq.trans cong sym_v)

end Jaide
```

```lean
        RSFField.double_half a
      have step9 : ((a - b) * RSFField.scale + (a + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = a :=
        Eq.trans step4 (Eq.trans step5 (Eq.trans step7 step8))
      have step10 : a + b - (a - b) = b + b :=
        RSFField.add_sub_self a b
      have step11 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale = (a + b - (a - b)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.sub_mul (a + b) (a - b) RSFField.scale)
      have step12 : (a + b - (a - b)) * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step10
      have step13 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((b + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step12
      have step14 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (b + b) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step15 : (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (b + b) * q) step6
      have step16 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq = b :=
        RSFField.double_half b
      have step17 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (a - b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = b :=
        Eq.trans step13 (Eq.trans step14 (Eq.trans step15 step16))
      prodEq step9 step17

theorem butterfly_right_inverse (z : α × α) :
    butterflyForward (butterflyInverse z) = z :=
  match z with
  | (a, b) =>
      have step1 : a + b - (b - a) = a + a :=
        RSFField.add_sub_swap a b
      have step2 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale = (a + b - (b - a)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.sub_mul (a + b) (b - a) RSFField.scale)
      have step3 : (a + b - (b - a)) * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step1
      have step4 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((a + a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step3
      have step5 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (a + a) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step6 : RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = RSFField.scale_sq :=
        Eq.refl (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale)
      have step7 : (a + a) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (a + a) * q) step6
      have step8 : (a + a) * RSFField.scale_sq = a :=
        RSFField.double_half a
      have step9 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale - (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = a :=
        Eq.trans step4 (Eq.trans step5 (Eq.trans step7 step8))
      have step10 : a + b + (b - a) = b + b :=
        RSFField.add_add_self a b
      have step11 : (a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale = (a + b + (b - a)) * RSFField.scale :=
        Eq.symm (RSFField.add_mul (a + b) (b - a) RSFField.scale)
      have step12 : (a + b + (b - a)) * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step10
      have step13 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = ((b + b) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale :=
        congrArg (fun q => q * RSFField.scale) step12
      have step14 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale = (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) :=
        RSFField.mul_assoc (b + b) RSFField.scale RSFField.scale
      have step15 : (b + b) * (RSFField.scale * RSFField.scale) = (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq :=
        congrArg (fun q => (b + b) * q) step6
      have step16 : (b + b) * RSFField.scale_sq = b :=
        RSFField.double_half b
      have step17 : ((a + b) * RSFField.scale + (b - a) * RSFField.scale) * RSFField.scale = b :=
        Eq.trans step13 (Eq.trans step14 (Eq.trans step15 step16))
      prodEq step9 step17

theorem layer_left_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (x : α × α) :
    layerInverse p (layerForward p x) = x :=
  have step1 : butterflyForward (couplingForward p x) = butterflyForward (couplingForward p x) :=
    Eq.refl (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x))
  have step2 : butterflyInverse (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x)) = couplingForward p x :=
    butterfly_left_inverse (couplingForward p x)
  have step3 : couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse (butterflyForward (couplingForward p x))) = couplingInverse p (couplingForward p x) :=
    congrArg (couplingInverse p) step2
  have step4 : couplingInverse p (couplingForward p x) = x :=
    coupling_left_inverse p x
  Eq.trans step3 step4

theorem layer_right_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (y : α × α) :
    layerForward p (layerInverse p y) = y :=
  have step1 : couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y) = couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y) :=
    Eq.refl (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y))
  have step2 : couplingForward p (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y)) = butterflyInverse y :=
    coupling_right_inverse p (butterflyInverse y)
  have step3 : butterflyForward (couplingForward p (couplingInverse p (butterflyInverse y))) = butterflyForward (butterflyInverse y) :=
    congrArg butterflyForward step2
  have step4 : butterflyForward (butterflyInverse y) = y :=
    butterfly_right_inverse y
  Eq.trans step3 step4

theorem map_left_inverse {β : Type u} (f g : β → β) (h : ∀ x : β, g (f x) = x) :
    ∀ l : List β, (l.map f).map g = l
  | [] =>
      have base : ([] : List β).map f = [] :=
        Eq.refl ([] : List β)
      have base2 : ([] : List β).map g = [] :=
        Eq.refl ([] : List β)
      Eq.trans (congrArg List.map base) base2
  | a :: t =>
      have ih : ((t.map f).map g) = t :=
        map_left_inverse f g h t
      have head : g (f a) = a :=
        h a
      have cons1 : (f a :: t.map f).map g = g (f a) :: (t.map f).map g :=
        Eq.refl ((f a :: t.map f).map g)
      have cons2 : g (f a) :: (t.map f).map g = a :: (t.map f).map g :=
        congrArg (fun u => u :: (t.map f).map g) head
      have cons3 : a :: (t.map f).map g = a :: t :=
        congrArg (fun u => a :: u) ih
      Eq.trans (Eq.trans cons1 cons2) cons3

theorem vector_left_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) :
    vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) = v :=
  have def1 : layerForward p = layerForward p :=
    Eq.refl (layerForward p)
  have def2 : layerInverse p = layerInverse p :=
    Eq.refl (layerInverse p)
  have h : ∀ x : α × α, layerInverse p (layerForward p x) = x :=
    layer_left_inverse p
  map_left_inverse (layerForward p) (layerInverse p) h v

theorem vector_right_inverse (p : LayerParams α) (v : List (α × α)) :
    vectorForward p (vectorInverse p v) = v :=
  have def1 : layerInverse p = layerInverse p :=
    Eq.refl (layerInverse p)
  have def2 : layerForward p = layerForward p :=
    Eq.refl (layerForward p)
  have h : ∀ x : α × α, layerForward p (layerInverse p x) = x :=
    layer_right_inverse p
  map_left_inverse (layerInverse p) (layerForward p) h v

theorem stack_left_inverse :
    ∀ (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (v : List (α × α)),
      stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) = v
  | [], v =>
      have base : stackForward [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      have base2 : stackInverse [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      Eq.trans (congrArg (stackInverse []) base) base2
  | p :: rest, v =>
      have rec : stackForward (p :: rest) v = stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) :=
        Eq.refl (stackForward (p :: rest) v)
      have rec2 : stackInverse (p :: rest) (stackForward (p :: rest) v) = vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v)) :=
        Eq.refl (stackInverse (p :: rest) (stackForward (p :: rest) v))
      have ih : stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v) = vectorForward p v :=
        stack_left_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)
      have step : stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v) = vectorForward p v :=
        ih
      have app : vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v)) = vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) :=
        congrArg (vectorInverse p) step
      have fin : vectorInverse p (vectorForward p v) = v :=
        vector_left_inverse p v
      Eq.trans app fin

theorem stack_right_inverse :
    ∀ (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (v : List (α × α)),
      stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) = v
  | [], v =>
      have base : stackInverse [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      have base2 : stackForward [] v = v :=
        Eq.refl v
      Eq.trans (congrArg (stackForward []) base) base2
  | p :: rest, v =>
      have rec : stackInverse (p :: rest) v = vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v) :=
        Eq.refl (stackInverse (p :: rest) v)
      have rec2 : stackForward (p :: rest) (stackInverse (p :: rest) v) = stackForward rest (vectorForward p (stackInverse rest v)) :=
        Eq.refl (stackForward (p :: rest) (stackInverse (p :: rest) v))
      have ih : stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) = v :=
        stack_right_inverse rest v
      have step : stackInverse rest v = v :=
        ih
      have mid : stackInverse rest v = v :=
        step
      have app : vectorForward p (stackInverse rest v) = vectorForward p v :=
        congrArg (vectorForward p) mid
      have fin : stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) = v :=
        stack_right_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)
      Eq.trans app fin

theorem stackForward_injective (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (u v : List (α × α))
    (h : stackForward ps u = stackForward ps v) : u = v :=
  have left_u : stackLeft_inverse ps u = u :=
    stack_left_inverse ps u
  have left_v : stack_left_inverse ps v = v :=
    stack_left_inverse ps v
  have sym_u : u = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) :=
    Eq.symm left_u
  have sym_v : v = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) :=
    Eq.symm left_v
  have cong : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) :=
    congrArg (stackInverse ps) h
  Eq.trans sym_u (Eq.trans cong sym_v)

theorem stackInverse_injective (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (u v : List (α × α))
    (h : stackInverse ps u = stackInverse ps v) : u = v :=
  have right_u : stack_right_inverse ps u = u :=
    stack_right_inverse ps u
  have right_v : stack_right_inverse ps v = v :=
    stack_right_inverse ps v
  have sym_u : u = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps u) :=
    Eq.symm right_u
  have sym_v : v = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) :=
    Eq.symm right_v
  have cong : stackForward ps (stackInverse ps u) = stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) :=
    congrArg (stackForward ps) h
  Eq.trans sym_u (Eq.trans cong sym_v)

end Jaide
```
entries.answer:
Ez **nem formálisan lezárt Lean-bizonyítás**, hanem egy jó szándékú, részben formálisnak kinéző vázlat, amely a megadott formában nagy valószínűséggel **nem fordul le**. A fő inverz-ötlet matematikailag helyes lehet, de vannak konkrét névhibák és egy lényeges indukciós hiba a `stack_right_inverse` tételben.

## Mi valódi benne?

A kód nem „dummy szimuláció” abban az értelemben, hogy tényleg Lean-szintű definíciókat és explicit egyenlőségi láncokat ír:

- `LayerParams` világosan rögzíti a szükséges nemnullasági feltételt:
  ```lean
  scaleFn_ne_zero : ∀ z : α, scaleFn z ≠ RSFField.zero
  ```
- A `couplingForward` és `couplingInverse` egymás inverzei lennének, feltéve hogy az `RSFField` axiómái valóban rendelkezésre állnak és konzisztensek.
- A butterfly-transzformáció inverzének bizonyítása ugyancsak algebrai azonosságokra épül.
- A lista-szintű `map_left_inverse` egy valódi strukturális indukció.
- A `stack_left_inverse` szerkezete elvileg helyes: először visszafejti a `rest` rétegeket, majd a jelenlegi `p` réteget.

Ha ez egy Lean-projektben hibamentesen lefordulna, akkor a Lean kernel valóban ellenőrizné a kapott termeket. Ez lenne a formális verifikáció erős értelme.

## Konkrét blokkoló hibák

### 1. Elgépelés: `stackLeft_inverse`

A `stackForward_injective` tételben ez szerepel:

```lean
have left_u : stackLeft_inverse ps u = u :=
  stack_left_inverse ps u
```

Viszont nincs `stackLeft_inverse` definíció vagy tétel. A deklarált név:

```lean
stack_left_inverse
```

Tehát legalább ezt javítani kell:

```lean
have left_u : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) = u :=
  stack_left_inverse ps u

have left_v : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) = v :=
  stack_left_inverse ps v
```

A jelenlegi annotáció nemcsak névhibás: a kívánt állítás explicit bal inverz-kompozíciót kell hogy tartalmazzon.

### 2. A `stack_right_inverse` indukciós lépése hibás

Itt:

```lean
have ih : stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) = v :=
  stack_right_inverse rest v

have step : stackInverse rest v = v :=
  ih
```

Ez típushiba. Az `ih` típusa:

```lean
stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) = v
```

de a `step` ezt próbálja úgy kezelni, mintha:

```lean
stackInverse rest v = v
```

lenne. Ez általában hamis is: `stackInverse rest v` nem azonos `v`-vel; csak akkor válik `v`-vé, ha utána alkalmazod rá a `stackForward rest`-et.

Ez a hiba azt mutatja, hogy a jobb inverz stack-bizonyítás nem egyszerűen egy változón végzett helyettesítéssel zárható le.

### 3. Az utolsó lépés nem a megfelelő állításból következik

A hibás ág végén:

```lean
have fin : stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) = v :=
  stack_right_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)
Eq.trans app fin
```

A `stack_right_inverse rest (vectorForward p v)` tényleg ezt adja:

```lean
stackForward rest (stackInverse rest (vectorForward p v)) =
  vectorForward p v
```

nem pedig:

```lean
stackForward rest (vectorForward p v) = v
```

Tehát ez sem csak Lean-szintű szintaktikai gond, hanem a kompozíciók sorrendje is össze van keverve.

## Mi a helyes bizonyítási szerkezet?

A definícióid szerint:

```lean
stackForward (p :: rest) = stackForward rest ∘ vectorForward p
stackInverse (p :: rest) = vectorInverse p ∘ stackInverse rest
```

Ezért a jobb inverz:

\[
F_{p::rest}(I_{p::rest}(v))
=
F_{rest}(F_p(I_p(I_{rest}(v))))
=
F_{rest}(I_{rest}(v))
=
v.
\]

A kulcslépés tehát **nem** az, hogy `stackInverse rest v = v`, hanem az, hogy:

```lean
vectorForward p (vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v))
  = stackInverse rest v
```

amit a `vector_right_inverse p (stackInverse rest v)` ad.

Egy helyesebb forma:

```lean
theorem stack_right_inverse :
    ∀ (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (v : List (α × α)),
      stackForward ps (stackInverse ps v) = v
  | [], v =>
      rfl
  | p :: rest, v =>
      have hv :
          vectorForward p (vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v)) =
            stackInverse rest v :=
        vector_right_inverse p (stackInverse rest v)
      have hcong :
          stackForward rest
              (vectorForward p (vectorInverse p (stackInverse rest v))) =
            stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) :=
        congrArg (stackForward rest) hv
      have hrest : stackForward rest (stackInverse rest v) = v :=
        stack_right_inverse rest v
      Eq.trans hcong hrest
```

Ezt lehet, hogy még a definíciók kibontásával kell segíteni (`show ...`, `change ...` vagy `simpa [stackForward, stackInverse]`), attól függően, pontosan hogyan viselkedik az importált környezet és a redukció.

## Az injektivitási tételek javítása

A bal inverz meglétéből a `stackForward` injektív, a jobb inverz meglétéből a `stackInverse` injektív. A gondolat helyes, de az első tételt javítani kell:

```lean
theorem stackForward_injective (ps : List (LayerParams α)) (u v : List (α × α))
    (h : stackForward ps u = stackForward ps v) : u = v :=
  have left_u : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) = u :=
    stack_left_inverse ps u
  have left_v : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) = v :=
    stack_left_inverse ps v
  have sym_u : u = stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) :=
    Eq.symm left_u
  have sym_v : stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) = v :=
    left_v
  have cong :
      stackInverse ps (stackForward ps u) =
        stackInverse ps (stackForward ps v) :=
    congrArg (stackInverse ps) h
  Eq.trans sym_u (Eq.trans cong sym_v)
```

A `stackInverse_injective` ugyanezzel az elvvel jó lehet, **miután** a `stack_right_inverse` ténylegesen bizonyított.

## Formális bizonyítás vagy nem?

A korrekt minősítés:

| Szempont | Értékelés |
|---|---|
| Matematikai terv | Alapvetően legitim |
| Lean-kód jelleg | Valódi Lean-bizonyítási kísérlet |
| Jelenlegi fordíthatóság | Nem megbízható; konkrét típus- és névhibák vannak |
| Kernel által ellenőrzött végbizonyítás | A bemutatott változat alapján nincs meg |
| „Mock/dummy/fake” | Nem tiszta mock, de a „formálisan verifikált” címkét még nem érdemli ki |

A döntő kritérium mindig az, hogy a teljes fájl egy konkrét Lean-verzióban, a konkrét `JaideVerification.Scalar` importtal **hiba nélkül lefordul-e**, és nincs-e benne `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` vagy olyan saját axiómakészlet, amely a kívánt állítást lényegében előre feltételezi. A bemásolt részben nincs `sorry`, ami jó jel, de az `RSFField` maga lényeges: ha az „algebrai törvények” ott axiómák, akkor a végső garancia feltételesen azokra az axiómákra épül.

Röviden: **az ötlet nem kamu, de ez a konkrét fájl jelenleg nem kész, nem forduló Lean-formalizáció; javítás után lehet belőle valódi kernel-ellenőrzött bizonyítás.**
